parameters.jsonBody:
={{
{
  "model": "mistral-nemo:latest",
  "stream": false,
  "format": "json",
  "prompt":
    "Tu es un assistant specialise en courtage hypothecaire au Quebec/Canada.\n\n" +
    "A partir de la transcription suivante, extrais les informations client au format JSON strict.\n\n" +
    "Regles importantes:\n" +
    "- N'invente aucune information.\n" +
    "- Si une information est absente, utilise null.\n" +
    "- Si une information est incertaine, utilise \"A valider\".\n" +
    "- Garde les montants, dates, noms et nombres exactement comme compris dans la transcription.\n" +
    "- Retourne uniquement un JSON valide, sans Markdown et sans texte autour.\n\n" +
    "Structure JSON obligatoire:\n" +
    "{\n" +
    "  \"nom_client\": null,\n" +
    "  \"telephone\": null,\n" +
    "  \"courriel\": null,\n" +
    "  \"type_emploi\": null,\n" +
    "  \"employeur\": null,\n" +
    "  \"revenu_annuel\": null,\n" +
    "  \"revenu_conjoint\": null,\n" +
    "  \"type_transaction\": null,\n" +
    "  \"prix_achat\": null,\n" +
    "  \"valeur_propriete\": null,\n" +
    "  \"solde_hypothecaire\": null,\n" +
    "  \"montant_financement\": null,\n" +
    "  \"mise_de_fonds\": null,\n" +
    "  \"provenance_mise_de_fonds\": null,\n" +
    "  \"dettes_totales\": null,\n" +
    "  \"objectif\": null,\n" +
    "  \"date_rappel\": null,\n" +
    "  \"informations_fiscales\": null,\n" +
    "  \"documents_requis\": [],\n" +
    "  \"points_a_valider\": [],\n" +
    "  \"prochaines_actions\": [],\n" +
    "  \"niveau_confiance\": null,\n" +
    "  \"resume\": null\n" +
    "}\n\n" +
    "Sections metier a couvrir dans le JSON:\n" +
    "1. Informations client -> nom_client, telephone, courriel\n" +
    "2. Situation d'emploi -> type_emploi, employeur, revenu_annuel, revenu_conjoint\n" +
    "3. Type de transaction -> type_transaction, objectif\n" +
    "4. Prix d'achat -> prix_achat\n" +
    "5. Montant de financement -> montant_financement\n" +
    "6. Mise de fonds -> mise_de_fonds\n" +
    "7. Provenance de la mise de fonds -> provenance_mise_de_fonds\n" +
    "8. Informations fiscales pertinentes -> informations_fiscales\n" +
    "9. Points a valider -> points_a_valider\n" +
    "10. Prochaines actions -> prochaines_actions\n\n" +
    "Transcription:\n" +
    $json.transcript
}
}}

parameters.query:
select c.*
from clients c
join representants r on r.representant_id = c.representant_id
where r.code_representant = '2026999999'
  and lower(trim(c.nom_client)) = lower(trim(nullif(nullif(nullif('{{ ($("Construire metadata JSON").item.json.metadata.database_payload.client_record.nom_client ?? "").replaceAll("'", "''") }}', ''), 'null'), 'undefined')))
limit 1;

WITH representant_cible AS (
    SELECT representant_id
    FROM representants
    WHERE code_representant = $1
    LIMIT 1
),

client_existant AS (
    SELECT
        c.client_id,
        c.representant_id,
        c.nom_client
    FROM clients c
    JOIN representant_cible r
        ON r.representant_id = c.representant_id
    WHERE LOWER(TRIM(c.nom_client)) = LOWER(TRIM($2))
    LIMIT 1
),

client_insere AS (
    INSERT INTO clients (
        representant_id,
        nom_client
    )
    SELECT
        r.representant_id,
        $2
    FROM representant_cible r
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM client_existant
    )
    RETURNING
        client_id,
        representant_id,
        nom_client
),

client_resultat AS (
    SELECT
        client_id,
        representant_id,
        nom_client,
        'existant'::text AS action_effectuee
    FROM client_existant

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        client_id,
        representant_id,
        nom_client,
        'insere'::text AS action_effectuee
    FROM client_insere
)

SELECT
    $3::jsonb AS payload_metier,
    client_id,
    representant_id,
    nom_client,
    action_effectuee
FROM client_resultat;

INSERT INTO interactions (
    client_id,
    representant_id,
    fichier_original_nom,
    transcription_originale_url,
    synthese_url,
    fiche_json,
    resume,
    niveau_confiance
)
VALUES (
    $1::uuid,
    $2::uuid,
    $3,
    $4,
    $5,
    $6::jsonb,
    $7,
    $8
)
RETURNING
    $9::jsonb AS payload_metier,
    interaction_id,
    client_id,
    representant_id,
    date_appel,
    type_interaction,
    fichier_original_nom,
    'interaction_creee' AS action_effectuee;

WITH documents AS (
    SELECT TRIM(document) AS document
    FROM regexp_split_to_table($4, ',') AS document
    WHERE TRIM(document) <> ''
),

documents_inseres AS (
    INSERT INTO documents_requis (
        client_id,
        interaction_id,
        representant_id,
        document
    )
    SELECT
        $1::uuid,
        $2::uuid,
        $3::uuid,
        document
    FROM documents
    RETURNING
        document_id,
        client_id,
        interaction_id,
        representant_id,
        document,
        statut,
        date_demande
)

SELECT
    $5::jsonb AS payload_metier,
    document_id,
    client_id,
    interaction_id,
    representant_id,
    document,
    statut,
    date_demande,
    'document_cree' AS action_effectuee
FROM documents_inseres;

WITH tache_inseree AS (
    INSERT INTO taches (
        client_id,
        representant_id,
        interaction_id,
        titre,
        description,
        date_echeance
    )
    SELECT
        $1::uuid,
        $2::uuid,
        $3::uuid,
        'Suivi des documents requis',
        NULLIF(TRIM($4), ''),
        NULL
    WHERE NULLIF(TRIM($4), '') IS NOT NULL
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM taches
          WHERE interaction_id = $3::uuid
            AND titre = 'Suivi des documents requis'
      )
    RETURNING
        tache_id,
        client_id,
        representant_id,
        interaction_id,
        titre,
        description,
        date_echeance,
        statut,
        created_at
)

SELECT
    $5::jsonb AS payload_metier,
    tache_id,
    client_id,
    representant_id,
    interaction_id,
    titre,
    description,
    date_echeance,
    statut,
    created_at,
    'tache_creee' AS action_effectuee
FROM tache_inseree;
